admission.justification: Several viewer routes share the media presentation and type contract, preventing one viewer from decoding pictures or videos as text while another renders them.

applicability: Direct supported picture and video content shown by File Viewer, change-set and review panes, notes panes, and the knowledge code view.
conditions: The fixed media table recognizes the file type.
The caller supplies its selected bytes address and available measured metadata.
An oversized result presents its size notice instead of a media element.
exclusions: Media embedded inside repository-document prose, whose address admission is owned by DocumentMarkdown.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §3; dashboard/src/panels/file-viewer/DualPane.test.tsx :: draws a picture from its bytes route, with its type and size under it; dashboard/src/panels/file-viewer/DualPane.test.tsx :: states a video above the bytes bound instead of requesting it; mcp/tests/test_serving_media.py::TableTests::test_only_the_fixed_table_is_media

statement: File, change-set, notes and knowledge-code presentations use the shared media component for supported pictures and videos, with the type and byte count below the media.
